question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Extensive
solution:
The correct answer is: **Limited**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Extensive"** means something that covers a large area or has a wide scope. (व्यापक)

 
 
• **Example: **The research project required extensive data collection from various sources.
 
 
 
• **"Limited"** refers to something that is restricted in size, amount, or extent. (सीमित)
 
 
• **Example: **The resources available for the project were quite limited.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Extensive' **is **'Limited'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Limited**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Abstract **(अमूर्त): Existing in thought or as an idea but not having a physical or concrete existence.

 
 
• **Example:** The artist's work is very abstract and open to interpretation.
 
 
 
• **Expensive **(महंगा): Costing a lot of money.
 
 
• **Example: **The new smartphone model is quite expensive.
 
 
 
• **Concrete **(ठोस): Existing in a material or physical form; real or solid.
 
 
• **Example:** The building's foundation is made of concrete.
